text:
Marta: Following the regional failover postmortem, listing follow-ups so we don't lose momentum. Need owners + concrete due dates.

Rohan: Root cause summary: route-reflector tie-breaker caused asymmetric path preference during cutover -> some traffic stayed in old region. Need fix in control-plane and a runbook guardrail.

Elise: I'll take the control-plane fix (tie-breaker fallback). ETA 2026-04-08. Will include an end-to-end test.

Ben: For the runbook guardrail, proposing a pre-cutover traffic-sample check with real-time mirroring to confirm steering.

Ben: For the runbook guardrail, proposing a pre-cutover traffic-sample check with real-time mirroring to confirm steering.

Marta: Good. Can you add that as a concrete checklist item and slot it into the game-day script?

Ben: Yep. Targeting 2026-03-29 to update the game-day script and add the mirroring step.

Taylor: Backup/restore note: we saw a corrupted snapshot manifest on one host. I'm triaging replication window and object-store retries. If replication is inconsistent we should add an integrity-check step.

Elise: For testing, I'll add staged failover with synthetic traffic. Need a 3-hour window in staging. ops-bot, can we reserve?

ops-bot: Calendar: Reserved 2026-03-30 13:00-16:00 UTC for staged failover testing. Invites sent to @oncall, @Elise, @Ben, @Marta.

infra-bot: Incident 2026-03-28-REG-FO: closed -> follow-ups created: 7. Linked: https://incident-tracker/redwood/2026-03-28-REG-FO.

Marta: Putting canonical AI list here (we'll sync to GH Projects + label "regional-failover-ai"):

```
AI-101 | Control-plane tie-breaker fallback fix    | owner: Elise  | due: 2026-04-08
AI-102 | Game-day pre-cutover mirroring check      | owner: Ben    | due: 2026-03-29
AI-103 | Snapshot integrity verifier               | owner: Taylor | due: 2026-04-01
AI-104 | Staged failover test in staging           | owner: Elise  | due: 2026-03-30
AI-105 | Runbook: explicit rollback criteria       | owner: Rohan  | due: 2026-04-04
AI-106 | Cross-region warm-standby cost estimate   | owner: Marta  | due: 2026-04-02
AI-107 | Incident labeling + weekly pattern digest | owner: Marta  | due: 2026-03-31
```

Rohan: I'll draft the rollback criteria and include signal thresholds (packet-loss > 2% OR steering mismatch > 20%).

Taylor: Snapshot verifier will be a small lambda to sanity-check manifests before we mark snapshots as "ready". I'll open a GH issue and a small PR.

Ben: I'll mock up the mirroring step config and share a snippet in #eng-runtime.

Marta: For the warm-standby cost, finance-bot can you run a ballpark with snapshot storage + regional EBS + cross-region transfer for a 7-day retention, warm compute reserve 2x r5.large equivalent?

finance-bot: Cost estimate task created: CE-4501. Preliminary ballpark: ~$6k/month for snapshot storage + replication + minimal compute standby. Final estimate due 2026-04-02.

Elise: I'll add an automated regression in CI that simulates route-reflector failover and validates steering.

Rohan: Also, we should tag incidents that match this pattern with "rr-rr-tiebreak" so SRE can run queries. Marta can you add that label to the last 60 days?

Marta: On it. I'll also enable a weekly digest to #eng-sre with counts + top labels.

ops-bot: Weekly digest scheduled: every Monday 09:00 UTC. First digest: 2026-03-30.

Ben: Quick blocker note: need mirror-capable tap on the A-region load balancer. Raising a hardware req if we can't get it via soft-mirror.

Taylor: If hardware needed, we'll escalate, but try soft-mirror first. I'll validate capacity by EOD.

Elise: Linking PRs and GH issues here as they land. Please add reviews for the staged test infra.

Marta: We'll review AI status next Wed in the DR sync. If any AI misses the due date, owner must post a short blocker note in this thread.

Rohan: Acknowledged. I'll draft the rollback doc and ping for review.

Ben: Thx team.

infra-bot: Follow-up checklist updated: 7 open AIs.

Marta: Closing thread for now; reopen if blockers come up.
